title: Add ASan/UBSan sanitizer test targets to Makefile
description:
There are no sanitizer build targets. For a crypto library handling sensitive data, AddressSanitizer catches heap overflows, use-after-free, and stack overflows. UBSan catches integer overflow, invalid casts, and misaligned access (all relevant to this codebase).

Add:
  test-asan: CFLAGS_EXTRA = -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all
  test-asan: LDFLAGS_EXTRA = -fsanitize=address,undefined
  test-asan: clean test

  test-ubsan: CFLAGS_EXTRA = -fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all
  test-ubsan: LDFLAGS_EXTRA = -fsanitize=undefined
  test-ubsan: clean test

These should run in CI. Add comment documenting that test-asan is the primary gate for memory safety.
